cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description:
Experience modern sailing comfort!

Our largest tiller-steer sailboat, the Catalina 250 is the perfect ocean or bay day-sailor. These fun, easily rigged sloops let you experience modern sailing comfort and excitement for up to 6 people. Equipped with walk through cabin and full head.
what_is_included:
- Max of 6 passengers *including children* 
- Sailing experience on similar size vessel required 
- Sailing Quiz required at check-in
- Must be 18+ to rent and operate
- Pets Allowed
- Life vests included (all sizes)

Must be 18+ to rent and operate

what_to_bring: Photo ID for all drivers and credit card used for payment required for check in.
